structured.answer: On the home page tap "להבין סוג של חיסכון" ("מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה"), then on the מדריך page tap "קרן השתלמות" (first link under "מאיפה להתחיל", also a card under "חיסכון עם הטבת מס"). Fairly sure, but my screenshots stop before the קרן השתלמות page itself.

stuck.why: The footer came very fast. For a second I thought that was the whole site.
So many similar cards that I'd only find mine because I already knew its name. The S&P 500 card is near the very bottom.

findings.what: Too many look-alike cards. You can only find yours if you already know its exact name.
S&P 500, the one friends talk about, is buried near the bottom among Tel Aviv indices
Card texts are full of jargon (מק"מ, צמודה, מנוטרלת)
The ₪ form takes the big spot on the home page, but I just wanted an explanation
The home page is very short and hits the footer fast, so it feels like there's nothing more
